input: Matongo ekare aibhuya ndaa dzekubudirira kwakapera kare, madziro awo emabwe akaparara asi akagara. Mizambiringa ne moss zvaihamba-hamba muzvikwereti, zvichikombidza kupfuura kwenguva uye kudzorera kwezvisikwa zvevanhu. Vandhu vanovona ndau vaihamba-hamba mu njira jo archways no mu maruvanze, vecirangarira upenyu hwaimbogara mukati mo zvivakwa izvi. Kunyarara kwainge kwakanyanya, kwaivhiringidzwa ngekuzwika kwetsoka ngekudanidzira kure kweshiri. Apo zuwa rainga rodoka sure kwe mapuwe, mimvuri yakareba, yoita kuti pave no mweya wo kutama kuzwisisa no kureremeja pa ndauyo. Chaiye chikarakadziso chekugara kwenhoroondo uye ndaa dzakabatanidzwa mubuwe rega rega.

Mundau yekuendesa ndege ine vanhu vakawanda, vafambi vakarumbire kupfuura ngekutarisira ngekushuvira. Mavhiri o mikwende aibhuya-bhuya pa ndau yakaceneswa apo mabhuyo o ndumi jakawanda aizara mu mhepo. Zvikirini zvemadhijitari zvaipenya nguwa dzekubuda ngekuguma, zveitungamira vafambi vasingaiti mwoyo murefu kana kudakara kuenda kwavanoenda. Makapu e kofi ne zviputiriso zve snack zvakapararira makona amweni, umboo hwe kukurumidza kurya kwe mangwanani ne kunasirisa kwe nguwa yekupeisira. Pakati pekuvhiringika kwakarongwa, pakava nekuzwisisa kwakagoverwa — nguwa inopera yekubatana pakati pevaeni vakasungwa ngechido chimwe chete chekuongorora, kupetuka, kana kutsvaka mavambo matsva. Rwendo rwaigara rwava kuda kuenderera mberi.

Pa chitsuwa icho chinoyevedza, masaisai akapfava anotenderera pamhenderekedzo yejecha rakachena, achikoka kuzorora uye kufungisisa. Miti ye michindwe yaizunguzika ngo usimbe mu mhepo yo mu gungwa, mufananidzo wayo waisiyana no mudenga wakajeka. Vandhu vaienda ku ndau iri phedo no gungwa vaizorora zuwa, vaivaka ndau jo jecha, zve vaiunganije mashell o gungwa, veciita zviro zvicizivi kuoma zvaiita inga paradhiso. Pashi po mvura, matombo anodakajisa maningi o coral aizara ngo zviro zvinorarama zvo mu jombe, zvinovoneka ngo mvura yakacena yaivonesa nyika yakafishika yo kushamisa. Painga peciguma madekoni, ndau yakacena ngo mavara o orenji no o pinki, zvokhombija kuti rimweni zuwa rainga rapera mu ndau iyi yakadekara. Kunaka kwakanyarara kwe chitsuwa ichi kwaipa nzvimbo tsvene kure ne ruzha rwehupenyu hwezuva nezuva.

Mu chivako che mahofisi chemazuva ano, vashandi vaibatana mumakamuri emusangano akashongedzwa ngegirazi uye ndau dzakavhurika dzekushandira. Kurira kwe makombiyuta ne kurira kwe mafoni kwaiita kuti pave nge ruzha rwe sure, rwuchipedzwa nge kudhinda ma keyboard ne kuvhiringidza mapepa. Makamuri ekuzorora akapa nguwa dzekuzorora, ngeshamwari dzevanoshanda nadzo veigovana kofi ngekubhuya zvisina shwiro. Mabhodhi machena nezvikirini zvaikombidza machati, nguwa dzeprojekiti, uye pfungwa dziri kuenderera mberi, zveshe zvichishanda kuende kune zvinangwa zvakafanana. Pasinei nekuti kwaive nekubatikana, paiva nechinangwa uye zvitsva zvaitsanangura kutsvaka kwemazuva ano kwekuenderera mberi uye kubudirira.

Chiteshi chechitima chakadzara vanhu chakashanda sechibatanidzo chekufamba, apo nyaya dzisingaverengeki dzakasangana. Vafambi vairumba kubata zvitima zvavo, vakabata zvikwama nemabhegi, imwe neimwe ine kwainoenda uye zviroto. Vatengesi vaitengesa zvikafu zvishoma nemapepanhau parutii rwezvitoro zvematiketi aidzokorora ngemazwi uye zviziviso. Chikuva chakadengenyeka ngekutarisira apo injini dzairira kuhupenyu, dzichiratidza kuenda nekuguma. Mundau iyi inopfuura, nguwa dzekubatana nekuvhakachira dzakasanganiswa, dzichidzokorora mimhanzi yehupenyu hwezuwa ngezuwa munyika isizi kumboema kuhamba.

Mukati mo mushango, civheneko co zuwa caisefa ngo mujira wo mashizha, cokanda mavara akasiyana-siyana pa nyika yakapfava iri pashi. Zvipuka zvemhando dzeshe zvaihamba zvinyararire mundau dzazvo dzekugara, chimwe ngechimwe cheita mushando wacho muwebhu yakaoma yehupenyu. Mhepo yainge yakapfuma ngeminhuwi ye moss, pine, uye mavhu akanyorova, ichimutsa kuzwa kwekugadzikana kwekare. Rukova rwakapfava rwaipinda mu miti, kupopoma kwaro kwaishanda inga rwiyo rwunozorodza ku ndau yakanyarara. Nzvimbo iyi tsvene isizi kubatwa yakaramba iri chipupuriro chekushinga kwazviro zvakasikwa uye kunaka kunogara kwezviro zvisina kubatwa.

Kichi yainge yakabatikana yakadzara ngezviitiko apo vabiki vaigadzira ndiro dzakawanda. Mutsindo unopisha unobva mu skillets wakasanganiswa no kunhuhwirira kwe mishonga, zvinonhuhwirira, no zvingwa zvipsa zvakabikwa, zvinoita kuti pave no ndau inokwevejera. Zviro zvokubikisa zvaicekwa, kuvhiringijwa, zve kusanganiswa ngo njira kwayo, cimwe nga cimwe caibesera kuti zviro zvizwirane. Vashandi vakahamba zvisina mutsindo pakati pezviteshi, vechibatana kuti ndiro imwe neimwe iende pakukwana. Vaenzi vakaemera kurya kwavo, kutarisira kuvakwa sezvo zvisikwa zvekubika zvakauya pamwepo — chikafu chimwe nechimwe mushando weunyanzvi wakagadzirirwa kudakadza pfungwa uye kugutsa mweya.

Mundau yekuonesa zviro, madziro akashongedzwa ngezviro zvakasiyana-siyana zvakapendwa, zvivezwa, nemafodho. Vaenzi vaihamba zvishomani kubva pane imwe ndau kuenda pane imwe ndau, umwe ngeumwe waiema kuti adudzire nekubonga zviratidzo zvevanyori. Mwenje wakavonesa mavara no zviro zvakadzama, zvoita kuti zviro zvaiitwa zvive no upenyu. Kubhuya kwakanyarara ngezve technique, manzwiro, uye zvinoreva zvakawedzera zvakadzama kune zvakaitika. Nzvimbo yainge iri ndau yakacheneswa yekugadzira nekufungisisa, apo simba rekuona rakakurudzira maonero matsva uye rakakurudzira kufungidzira.

Mangwanani-ngwanani pa damu, mhute yakakwira zvinyoro-nyoro kubve pashi po mvura, yoita kuti pave no mujimu wo ethereal. Matatya aikwasva ngekunonoka, eisiya mafungu mukumuka kwawo, apo madhimoni airumba pamusoro pematsanga. Kunyarara kwe mangwanani kwaiparadzwa nge kurira kwakapfava kwe shiri dzinoimba dzinoashira zuwa. Miti yakapoteredza yairatidza mumvura yakadzikama, ichiwedzera kunzwa kwekudzikama kaviri. Nguwa iyi yakanyarara yakasanganisa kunaka kwakanyarara kwezviro zvakasikwa nyika isati yamuka zvakakwana, yeitikarakadzisa ngezve runyararo rwunowanikwa mukutenderera kwezviro zvakasikwa.

Mwenje ye theatre yakadzima apo chidziro chakakwira, ichikombidza chikuva chakagadzirirwa kuita chisingakanganwiki. Vatambi vakapinda muzvigaro zvavo, embodying vatambi nechido uye kuvimba, kuunza nyaya kuhupenyu. Vateereri vakabatikana, kuseka nekurova maoko zvaipedza nguva dzinorwadza uye kutendeuka kunoshamisa. Mimhanzi ne mwenje zvakasimudzira mazwiro uye mhepo, zvichichinja nzvimbo kuita ndau yekufungidzira uye kushamisika. Apo chiito ichi chakapera, kuombera kwakatanga, kupemberera unyanzvi uye kuedza kwakaita kuti chiito chive chisingambofi chakapotsa kune vese.

Mu ndau jainga jakanyarara, nyumba jainga jakaema mu mitsara yakacena, imwe nga imwe yainga no munda wayo wakadzara maruva no maruva. Munjira mwainge mwakadzara hope dzakajairika uye kuguqa hloko kweushamwari, zvinokhombidza kuzwa kwemunharaunda uye kugadzikana. Vana vaitamba mu maruvanze apo vasharuka vaiita mushando kana kuita hurukuro pa maveranda. Kurira kwakapfava kwehupenyu hwezuwa ngezuwa kwakagadzira nzvimbo inonyaradza, ichisimbisa kukosha kwepamba uye kubatana. Apo madekoni, kupenya kwakapfava kwe mwenje dze pa veranda kwakaashira usiku, kugara mu runyararo rwe upenyu hwe kumaruwa.

Njira yemugomo yakapinda mudenga kuburikidza ngendau dzakaoma, ichidenha vanokwira makomo vane makomo akakwirira uye ngemabwe. Nhanho imwe neimwe yaida kushanda ngo simba no kujipira, zve zvaizopuwa ngo kuvona zviro zvinodakajisa maningi pa musongano. Mhepo inotonhorera yo mu gomo yaiita kuti mwoyo uite simba, maruva o mushango no zvirimwa zvakasimba zvaibatirira pa ndau dzakatsemuka jo matombo. Pano no nguva, kucema ko gondo ku ndau iri kure kana kuvona mbuji yo mu gomo kwaiceukija vandhu vaida kuzvidakajisa ngo pamusoro po kunaka ko mushango kwakavatendeneja. Kuguma pachikomo kwaiva nguwa yekukunda, chipupuriro chekushingaira uye simba rinoshamisa rezvisikwa.

Musika wo mu dhorobha ro kare wainga no zviro zvakawanda, vatengesi vaidanijira zviro zvavo zve vandhu vaitenga vaitengesa ngo kudakara. Mastafu akadzara nge zviro zvakagadzirwa nge nyara, zvinonhuhwirira, nge micheka, chiro chimwe ngachimwe chaimirira chikamu che tsika dzakapfuma dze guta. Kunhuhwirira kwezvikafu zvisingaziikanwi kwakadzara mweya, kuedza vaipfuura kuti vaone zvinonaka zvitsva. Mutsindo wemimhanzi nekutamba kubva kune vatambi vaive pedyo zvakawedzera mhepo inodakadza. Ndau iyi yainga no vanhu vakawanda yainga isipi ndau yo kutengesera basi; kwaiva muchinjiko wenhoroondo, tsika, uye kubatana kwevanhu.

Pasi po mudenga hwo usiku, mwoto wo musasa waipenya-penya woita mimvuri inojaivha pa hope jo vandhu vaihamba vakaremba. Vacibhuya ndaa no kuimba ngoma, vaidakara ngo kudakara kwakapfava ko ushamwari. Mwoto waipenya-penya waipa kudziya pamusoro pemhepo inotonhorera, apo nyeredzi dziri pamusoro dzaipa chidziro chemudenga chekushamisika kusingaperi. Kudaidza kwe zizi kuretu nekutinhira kwemashizha kwakaita kuti pave ngendau inozorodza. Mu nguva ino, yakatenderedzwa nge zviro zvakasikwa nge shamwari, nguwa yakaita inga yakaema, yeisimbisa kukwezva kusingaperi kwe kutamba kwe kubanze.

Musangano wezvidzidzo wakaunganidza pamwepo vadzidzisi vanobva munyika dzeshe kuti vagovane pfungwa uye nekubhuya ngezvezviro zvitsva. Vakurukuri vanokosha vakapa hurukuro dzinokurudzira, vakatungidza mitsara mitsva yekubvunza uye kubatana. Nguwa dzekuparadzana dzakakurudzira kukurukura, kukurudzira nharaunda yepfungwa dzinoda kuziya. Kuchinjana kweruzivo kwakawedzeredzwa ngezviitiko zvekubatana uye zviitiko zvetsika, kupfumisa ruzivo kupfuura zvedzidzo. Apo musangano wakapera, vatori vechikamu vakaendesa mberi maonero matsva uye kubatana kunokona kuitika, zvichikonzera kuenderera mberi muminda yavo.

Mvura yakanaya zvinyoro-nyoro pamusoro peguta, ichiita kuti pombi iite rhythm pamahwindo uye padenga remhatso. Vafambi vairumba pasi pe masamburera, nhanho dzavo dzairumbire asi dzisingakurumidzi, sezvo zviratidzo zvaipenya pamugwagwa wakanyorova. Kunhuhwirira kwenyika yakanyorova uye mvura inonaya yakachena yakasimudzira pfungwa, ichipa nguva yekugadzirisa pakati pehupenyu hwemutaundi. Mwenje yemunjira inopenya ngegoridhe, kusiyana ngedenga rinotonhorera, weiwedzera kudziya kwakanaka pandau. Kurerukirwa nekudzikama zvakatsiva kushungurudzika kwekutanga, sezvo guta rakagamuchira kumbundirana kunonyaradza kwemvura inonaya, ichiyeuchidza munhu weshe simba rakapfava rechisikwa.

Mhatso yekare yakaema sechipupuriro cheunyanzvi hwevanhu uye zvekunamata, madziro ayo emabwe akashaishirwa ngemazana emakore emhepo uye mamiriro ekunze. Zvivezwa zvakaoma uye zvifananidzo zvakashongedza mberi kwayo, zvichizevezera nyaya dzekuzvipira uye ngano. Vafambi nevaenzi vakawana kunyaradzwa nekukurudzirwa mukati menzvimbo dzayo dzakanyarara, apo runyararo nekuremekedza kwakadzara mhepo. Kuvepo kwe tembere kwakabatanidza zvakapfuura ne zvamazuva ano, zvichishanda sechiyeuchidzo chakachena che nhaka yetsika uye nekutsvaka zvinoreva zvinogara zvakadaro. Apo chiedza chezuwa chaipinda mumapako nemapako, kuzwa kusingaperi kwakafukidza ndau iyo.

Carnival yaidakadza yainge iri chiratidzo chemavara, izwi, uye kudakadza. Rides dzakatenderera uye dzakakwira, dzakadzara kushevedzera kwekudakara, apo zvitoro zvemitambo zvaipa mikana yemibairo uye kuseka. Vatambi vakasimira ngubo vakadakadza mhomho yeanthu ngemitambo yekutamba, mashiripiti, ngezviito zvemimhanzi, zvichibata fungidziro dzemazera eshe. Kunhuhwirira kwezviwitsi zvedonje, chibage, uye soseji yakagochwa yakakwezva vaiuya kuti vazvipise. Apo usiku hwainga hwaguma, mwenje jainga jecipenya no mimhanzi zvaiita kuti pave no mugariro wakagwinya waipemberera kudakara, nharaunda, no kudakara kusizi kuoma ko upenyu.

Mukona ye raibhurari yakanyarara, tafura imwe yainga yakajekeswa ngo mwenje, yecikoka muerengi kuti arashikirwe ngo bhuku. Mapeji aya ainge akabata nyika dzekutamba, ruzivo, uye manzwiro, imwe neimwe musuwo wekuzwisisa patsva kana kutiza. Kunyarara kwakapoteredza kwakasimudzira kufunga uye kufungisisa, nzvimbo tsvene kubva kune nyonganyonga iri kubanze. Pedyo, mashelufu akarongwa nge chidzidzo uye munyori akapa tapestry yakapfuma yepfungwa dzevanhu uye kugadzira. Ndau iyi yekuda kuziya yakakombidza simba rinogara rekuerenga kukurudzira, kufundisa, nekushandura.

Munda wo mizambiringa wakatambanuka pa zvikomo zvinozungunyika, mizambiringa yawo yairema ngo mazambiringa akaibva akagadzirira kukukura. Vashandi vaihamba ngo njira yakarongeka pakati po mitsara, vecitema no kutema, umwe nga umwe waingwarira ndau ngo ungwaru no uzivi. Zuwa rakaisa ruvara rwegoridhe pamusoro penyika yakasvibira, richiwedzera ruvara rwemaruva anopenya uye ruvara rwepepuru rwakadzama. Mhepo yakadzara ngeminhuwi inotapirira yemichero ngevhu, inosanganisira kukosha kwehupenyu hwekurima. Apo nguva yo kukukura yainga yoguma, kuvetera kwakakura ngo pamusoro po waini jainga jicikazonasirihwa ngo mapoka aya anosisira maningi.

Taundi rainga rakavharwa ngo chando rainga ndau yakakwana yo muchando, pa padera po nyumba painga pakavharwa ngo ngubo jena zve icicles jainga jakarembera pa ndhambo. Munjira mainge akanyarara, akadzimwa ngekudonha kwakapfava kwechando, zvichiita kuti pave nerunyararo. Vana vakaaka snowmen uye vaiita hondo dze snowball, kuseka kwavo kwairira mumhepo inotonhora. Mwenje inodziya yaibva mudzimba dzekugara nezvitoro yaisiyana zvakanaka ngendau inotonhora, ichimutsa kuzwa kudakara kwakanaka. Nharaunda yeshe yaiita inga inopenya nge mashiripiti e nguwa, ichikoka veshe kuti vagamuchire kunyarara kwe nguwa ye chando.

Mu dhorobha ro kuendesa zviro zvo kuendesa zviro no zvikepe zvo kubata hove zvaibhururuka pa ndau inogara zvikepe, mapondo azvo aiguma mugore. Vashandi vepachikepe vakahamba ngekukasira, vechiisa nekuburudza zviro zvaiita kuti hupfumi hweguta rive nesimba uye zvaiibatanidza nenyika yeshe. Mabhizimisi emusika aiva parutivi pe quay aipa zviro zvitsva zvakabatwa, zviro zvakaitwa ngenyara, nezviyeuchidzo zvevafambi nevemunharaunda zvakafanana. Kunhuhwirira kwemvura yemunyu, chikafu chegungwa, uye dizeli zvakasanganiswa mumhepo, zvinoratidza kukosha kwehupenyu hwegungwa. Apo ngarava jainga jecienda kana kuguma, dhorobha raibudirira ngo kuhamba, kutengeserana, no kukwevehwa ngo gungwa.

Unyanzvi hwekubika hwakazadza ndau yekubikira ngekunhuhwirira kunodziya, kunokoka kwaikwezva vaipfuura ngepo kuti vapinde mukati. Chingwa no zviro zvakabikwa zvipsa zvairongwa ngo ungwaru mu zviro zvo kuvonesa, zviro zvazvo zvo goridhe no zviro zvakapfava zvaiedza mwoyo. Vabiki vaiimba-imba pavaikanya fufu no kunasira zvingwa, uzivi hwavo hwaioneka mu zviro zvese. Vatsigiri vakadakarira nzvimbo yakanaka, vechinakidzwa ngekofi kana tii, vechibhuya ngezvezviro zvakabikwa. Mushando wo kubika uwu auzi kungopa zvokuha basi asi wakabatanavo vandhu ngo njira yo tsika, kugadzira zviro, no kudakara kusizi kuoma ko zvokuha zvakanaka.

Pakati pemushando wakadzara vanhu, vashandi vakashanda ngekushingaira pazviro zvavo, chikamu chimwe nechimwe chaikombidza unyanzvi uye chido. Zviro zvaishandiswa kubve kumapuranga ngesimbi kuguma kumajira ngedhaka, nevanogadzira zviro vaishandura zviro zvisizi kugadzirwa kuita zviro zvinoshanda. Mutsindo we saw, nyundo, ne looms wakasanganiswa kuita rwiyo rwezvisikwa. Vaenzi vaiyemura hunyanzvi, kazhinji vaikurudzirwa kutevera zvavo zveunyanzvi. Mushando uwu wakakhombise ungwaru hwo vandhu no kudakarira kunogara kwe zviro zvakaitwa ngo nyara, zvinoreva zviro.

Munguwa ye mutambo unodakadza, zviphambano zvakashongedzwa nge maruwa nge mwenje zvakahamba munjira, zveipemberera nhaka ye tsika nge mweya we nharaunda. Vatambi vakapfeka ngubo vakajaivha ngekuridza mimhanzi, vechikwezva vaoni vemazera eshe. Matafura ezvekurya akapa zvikafu zvekudhaya, kugovana zvinonaka kubva kumarudzi apfuura. Mhepo yakadzara ngekudakara, kuseka, ngekudakara kweshe kwekutora rutivi. Pakaguma usiku, zviro zvinopenya zvaijekesa mudenga, zveikombidza magumo echiitiko chinodakadza, chisingambofi chakaunganidza anhu pamwepo pakupemberera.

Maruwa akanyarara ainge akazara ngeminda nemasango, apo nguva yaiita inga iri kunonoka. Varimi vaichengeta zvirimwa nezvipfuwo, maitiro avo akadzika midzi mumazana emakore etsika. Misha midoko yakagara pakati pezvirimwa, ine dzimba dzaibudisa kunaka kwe rustic. Mutsindo wakapfava we zviro zvakasikwa — shiri dzinoimba, mhepo inovhuvhuta kuburikidza nge mashizha, moo ye mwombe iri kure — yakagadzira mutsindo unozorodza. Nharaunda iyi yakaisvonaka yaipa kudzokera kubva kuhupenyu hwemutaundi, ichiyeuchidza vaeni runyararo uye kureruka kunowanikwa mukumbundirana kwezviro zvakasikwa.

Muchipatara chemazuva ano, vashandi vehutano vakashanda vasingaremi kuti vachengete varwere, kuzvipira kwavo kunooneka muchiito chese. Nharaunda isina chiro yainge iri ndau yekuita zviro, nevanamukoti navanachiremba vaironga kurapwa nekuongorora zviratidzo zvakakosha. Tekinoroji yepamusoro yakabatsira kuongorora uye kupora, inosanganisira kusanganiswa kwetsitsi uye zvitsva. Varwere vakawana kunyaradzwa muunyanzvi uye mutsa wevashandi, vachivimba ngechinangwa chavo chekudzorera hutano uye kugara zvakanaka. Nzvimbo iyi yaive chipupuriro chekushinga kwavanhu uye kuenderera mberi nekutsvaka kurapwa.

Gwenga rainga rakatambanuka ricikaperi, ndau yakakura maningi yo jecha no ndau jakaoma jo matombo pashi po zuwa rinopisa maningi. Cacti nezvirimwa zvakasimba zvakabatirira pahupenyu munharaunda iyi yakaoma, kushinga kwazvo kunokurudzira kutya. Vafambi vaihamba mu ndau iyi ngo kungwarira, veciziva ngozi no kunaka kwakabatana mu ndau iyi yo mu ndau yakashata. Mirages yaipenya kuretu, zviro zvokunyepa zvaitamba madziso asi zvaiwedzera mystique ye ndau. Kuvira kwezuwa kwakashandura gwenga kuita ruvara rwetsvuku rwemwoto nemaorenji, chiono chinopfuura chesimba risina kugadzirwa rezvisikwa uye kunaka kunoshamisa.

Kamba yakadziya yakaiswa pakati pemiti yakareba yaipa nzvimbo tsvene kubva kunyika yekunze. Nzvimbo dzemoto dzakapenya, dzichikanda kupenya kunodziya kwakazadzisa kushongedza kwe rustic. Vaenzi vakazorora nemabhuku kana kugoverana ndaa, veidakara ngekunyarara kwekudzokera kwavo. Pabanze, chando cakawa ngo kupfava, cofukija ndau ngo ruva rakacena, asi mukati, kudziya no kunyaradzwa kwaitonga. Nharaunda iyi yakabatana yakasanganisira kudzokera kune zviri nyore uye kunyaradzwa kunowanikwa mukumbundirana kwezvisikwa, kutiza kwakakwana kwekuzorora uye kuvandudzwa.

Mu ndau inodakajisa yo mu dhorobha, vatambi vakanasirira sure kwe ndau, mwoyo wavo no kudakara kwavo zvaioneka. Orchestra yakagadzirisa zviridzwa zvavo apo kuombera nekutaura kwakadzara muimba yekuungana. Paakasimuka chidziro, chikuva chakashanduka kuva nyika yemitambo, mitambo inoshekedza, kana njodzi, ichikwezva vateereri uye ichiita kuti vapindure mafungiro. Kubatana kwekuita — vatambi, vaimbi, vashandi vepachikuva — vakagadzira mushando wekupfuura wakangovapo panguwa iyoyo. Apo chiitiko chekupeisira chakapera uye kuombera kwakatanga, mashiripiti e theatre akakarakadzisa munthu weshe simba rekubhuya ndaa nekuronza kwemunhu.

Runyararo monastery ruvanze yaiva nzvimbo yekufungisisa uye kudzikama. Vafundisi vaihamba zvinyararire mu cloisters, vecichengeta minda no kunasirira minamato yo njiku ngo njiku. Kunhuhwirira kwezvinonhuhwirira uye maruva anotumbuka akawedzera kune mweya, kukurudzira pfungwa uye kudzikama. Vaenzi kana vagari vakawana kunyaradzwa mukureruka uye kurangwa kwehupenyu hwemonastic, apo kufungisisa uye nharaunda zvakabatana. Yakasungirirwa mutsika dzemazana emakore ekare, ndau iyi yakachena yakapa ndau yakachena yemweya pakati penyonganyonga yenyika yekunze.

Pa ndau yaiitwa basa ro kuvaka, vashandi vakabatana kuti vaake ndau itsva, umwe nga umwe waipa uzivi hwake. Kuzwika kwe simbi ne kuzwika kwe michini kwaikombidza kuenda mberi, nepo mitemo yekuchengeteka yaichengeta munhu weshe akachengeteka. Zviro zvakaguma mu rukova rwakagadzikana — simende, matanda esimbi, zvidhina — chikamu chimwe nechimwe chakakosha pakuvimbika kwebasa. Vagadziri vemapuranga nevainjiniya vakatarisira mushando, vechiona kuti dhizaini yakazadziswa ngekugondeka. Ndau iyi yainga tesitamende yo kuda kwa vandhu no kushanda pamwepo kwaidiwa kuti zvirongwa zvive zvokadi.

Matombo e coral anopenya aizara nge upenyu pashi pe mvura yakachena ye gungwa. Zvikora zvo hove jakasiyana-siyana zvairumba pakati po matavi o coral, apo mhuka jo mu gungwa jakaseja jainga jecihamba-hamba. Nharaunda yakaoma ye reef yakatsigira mhando dzakawanda, imwe neimwe inoita basa rakakosha pakuchengetedza kuenzana. Vandhu vanoita snorkel no vanoshambira vakavona paradhiso iyi yo pasi po mvura, vakashamaiswa ngo kunaka kwayo no kusiyana-siyana kwayo. Kudzivirira ndau idzi dzisina kusimba kwakakosha yaamho kuchengetedza upfumi hwehupenyu hwemugungwa kune mazera anouya.

Mu tembere yo ciBhudha yainga yakanyarara, vafundisi vaiita zviro zvokuita no kurangarira, zvoita kuti pave no mugariro wo kujidodokesa no kusotesesa zviro zvo kumujimu. Kunhuhwirira kwezvinonhuhwirira kwaipinda mumhepo apo nziyo dzaidzokororwa zvinyoro-nyoro, dzichitungamirira vashandi mukati. Zvifananidzo nemifananidzo yevamwari zvaipa ndau dzinokosha dzekunamata nekufungisisa, zvichikurudzira kuzwa kubatana nekuremekedza. Vaenzi vaitsvaka runyararo no kuzwisisa vakawana kunyaradzwa mukunyarara kusingaperi kwe tembere. Nzvimbo dzakachena dzakadaro dzaishanda senzvimbo yekuongorora mukati uye kukudziridza tsitsi.

Nharaunda inodakajisa yo ski yainga yakadzara ngo zviro zvaiitwa apo vandhu vanoita ski no vanoita snowboard vaihamba mu ndau jainga no chando no mu njira jo mu makomo. Zvigaro zvinosimudza zvaitakura vaenzi kuenda kumakomo, zvichipa maonero akanaka enyika yakavharwa ngechando. Musure mwe zuwa rekutamba, vaenzi wakaungana mundau dzekugara dzakanaka, vechibhuya ndaa nekudziya ngekudziya nge mwoto waibvunza. Kunhuhwirira kwe chocolate inopisa uye zvikafu zvinodakadza zvakadzara mweya, zvichiwedzera mhepo inotevera yekudakara. Ndau iyi yekutamba yemuchando yainga yekupemberera adrenaline, zviro zvakasikwa, no ushamwari, zvoita kuti vandhu vakarakadze nguva yakareba pasure po kunyungudika ko chando.

Mukati mwe laboratório yakaoma, masaindisiti akaita zvakanaka kuedza, achivimba ngekunyatsojeka uye unyanzvi. Midziyo yaipenya pashi pezvivheneko zvinopenya apo vaiongorora mienzaniso uye vainyora ruzivo, veitsvaka ruzivo rwenyika yechisikirwo kana kuenda mberi kwezvekugadzirwa kwezviro. Kubatana nekuda kuziya zvakakonzera mushando wavo, kazhinji zvaikonzera kubudirira kunokona kukanganisa vanhu zvakanaka. Nharaunda yainge yakasanganiswa nekurongeka kwakadzorwa uye kutsvaka kusina muganhu, inosanganisa mweya wemunhu wekuwana nekugadzira zviro zvitsva. Mugumisiro wese wakaita kuti pave no kutsvaka kukuru ko kuzwisisa no kuenderera mberi.

Chitoro chemabhuku chakanaka paMain Street chakakwezva vanoda mabhuku ngechiso chacho chinokoka uye mashelufu anoputika ngemavhoriyamu. Vaerengi vakaongorora zvakanaka zvakaunganidzwa, vakawana vanyori vatsva uye zvinyorwa zvisingaperi zvakafanana. Kunhuhwirira kwepepa rakare kwakafukidza vaeni, kuchiwedzera kudakara kwekubata kwekuwana nyaya neruzivo. Vashandi vanoshamwaridzana vakapa mazano, kuwedzera kubata kwemunhu kune ruzivo. Iyi ndau yekugara ye mabhuku yakasimudzira nharaunda, kufungidzira, uye kufunda, kukudziridza hukama pakati pemazwi neavo vanoakoshesa.

Mu munda wakakura wo zvirimwa, zvirimwa zvakasvibira zvo mu nyika yese zvaivoneswa mu zvikamu zvakarongwa ngo ungwaru. Njira dzaitenderera kuburikidza ngemaruva anopenya, zvidziva zvakadzikama, uye arboretums ine mumvuri, ichikoka kuongorora uye kudzikama. Varimi vavo vaingwarira ngo rudo cirimwa cimwe nga cimwe, veciita kuti zvirimwa zvicikawaniki zvigare zvakanaka zve ndauyo ive yakanaka. Vandhu vaiuya kovona vaishamisika ngo kusiyana-siyana ko maruva, vecijija ngo pamusoro po ukama huri pakati po zviro zvinorarama no njira jo kusima ndijo. Munda wakashanda inga ndau yakaceneswa ku vandhu vanoziva no vandhu vapsa, ndau inorarama yo zvishamiso zvo zviro zvakasikwa no ungwaru hwo vandhu.

Paki yo kudakara yaidakajisa maningi yainga no kudakara no kutonhora ngo ma roller coaster, mavhiri o Ferris, no mitambo. Mwenje yakajeka no mimhanzi inodakajisa zvakaita kuti pave no mugariro wo simba wakakwevera mapoka o vandhu vaibva phedo no kure. Vana nevakuru vakaona nguwa dzekudakara nekudakara, vakabata zvikarakadzo pakati pekudakara nekusakosha. Concession stands yakapa zveshe kubve ku cotton candy kuguma ku snacks dzinonaka, zveiita kuti munhu aenderere mberi nekutamba. Chiitiko ichi chekudakadza nekusheka chakapemberera kureruka nekudakara kwekuzvivaraidza pasina kuneseka, kukarakadzisa mundhu weshe kudakara kunowanika muzviitiko zvakagoverwa.

Mundau yekugara yakadzikama yekumaruwa, vaenzi wakadakarira kudzokera murugare kubva kune kushungurudzika kwehupenyu hwezuva ngezuva. Midziyo yerustic uye mwenje inodziya yakagadzira nzvimbo inodziya, nepo chikafu chinodakadza chinopa kunyaradza uye kudzingwarira. Nharaunda yakatenderedza yaive neminda inotenderera uye miti yakanyarara, yakakwana kuhamba uye kufungisisa. Kuashira vaeni kwa mundhu waigara pa ndau yo kugara, kwaiita kuti vandhu vajizwe inga vari pamuzi pavo zve vakazorora, zvoita kuti vandhu vajizwe inga vari pamuzi pavo. Iyi ndau yekugara isizi kuoma uye yakasikwa yakapa kumboema kunosimudzira, kubatanidzazve vafambi nekunonoka, nekukurumidza kwehupenyu hwekumakanyi.

Muziyamu yakajeka, yemazuwa ano yakakombidza mhando dzakasiyana siyana dzehunyanzvi, nhoroondo, uye zviratidzo zvesainzi. Vaenzi vakahamba kuburikidza nezviratidzo zvakanyatsogadzirwa, vachibatana nezvinhu zvinokurukura uye mapaneri anodzidzisa. Kuvakwa kwaro kwaiva mushando weunyanzvi, kusanganisira kugadzirwa kwezviro zvitsva kuti zviwedzere zviratidzo mukati. Zvirongwa zvekudzidzisa uye zviitiko zvakakosha zvakakurudzira kuda kuziva uye kudzidza. Muziyamu yakashanda sebhiriji rinobatanidza zvakapfuura, zvazvino, uye ramangwana, kukurudzira vaenzi kuti vabonge kugadzirwa kwevanhu uye ungwaru muzvidzidzo zveshe.

Pa musoro po cikomo cakanyarara, painga no ndau yokudira yainga yakavona ndau yakatendeneja, ndhambo yayo yainga yeciguma mugore. Vafambi no vandhu vaiviya kuzowana kunyarajwa, kuita mukumbiro, kana kungodakajihwa ngo kuvona zviro zvakanaka. Madziro emabwe uye mukati akapfava aikombidza kuzvininipisa uye kuremekedza, kukurudzira nguva dzekufungisisa uye kubatana. Njira yondhoyo yainga yeciceukija kuti vandhu vanoramba vecitsvaka kukura no kuzwisisa kumujimu. Pakuvira kwezuwa, ndau yekudira yakaoneka sechiedza chetariro nerunyararo pakati pekuwanda kwezviro zvakasikwa.
